France Adopts Fairer World Map Ahead of UN Vote on More Balanced Geography

2026-09-04 Le Monde France, Mercator, Eckert IV, Correct the Map, cartography, diplomacy, Jean-Noël Barrot
Read the source article

Quick summary

France officially abandoned the Mercator projection in its diplomatic representations, adopting the Eckert IV projection ahead of the UN vote on the "Correct the Map" resolution.

Key takeaways

  • France dropped Mercator in favour of the Eckert IV projection for official world maps
  • French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot announced the change at La Fabrique de la Diplomatie
  • France, the US, and Russia will appear noticeably smaller on the new maps
  • The shift is both symbolic and geopolitical, reflecting France's support for the African-led initiative
  • Barrot framed the change as both accurate representation and narrative shaping
